name: sb-npf-contribution-reference
description: Conditional Solomon Islands ordinary monthly National Provident Fund contribution reference using the authorised Act as at 5 February 2024. Illustrates payment-occasion wage precision, complete-dollar contributions, half-cent rounding of each employee's monthly total and the separately recoverable employee portion. Use for SINPF contribution arithmetic and wage-base rounding questions. Requires the universal and social contributions workflow bases. Fictional examples stipulate established coverage, period allocation and absence of overriding treatment. Actual current law, coverage, recovery, remittance, income tax, payroll and other programmes remain held. This is a source-cited draft, not comprehensive jurisdiction acceptance.
